VI.description: NI Vision's Image Display indicator (style Image Display on an IMAQ Image), the panel object that draws the image: IMAQ Create, IMAQ ArrayToImage fills it from a 2D U8 array, IMAQ GetImageSize reads it back. The image is NOT disposed, so the display keeps it.

FreeLabel.comment: Fill an image and show it
